name: Grid Row Template (Line-Item Table)
description: This codebase has NO DevExpress data-grid widget for line-item editing (confirmed: zero dxDataGrid/dataField/columns usage anywhere except one unrelated dxpivotgrid report). Every editable 'grid' is actually a type:'list' repeating a row template of sect/div/control atoms per dataset row. Always build new line-item tables this way, never introduce a dxDataGrid.
composedOf: any control atom bound with rowindex

columns.description: List of { xs, control } — control is a control-atom template with rowindex:'[this.propkey]' set.

note: Add one more 'sect item' cell per column, adjusting xs to fit the 12-column row. The row's className expression '[raw.facts-row-[this.row_error]]' wires row-level validation state (see molecules/validation-grid-rows.json) directly into row highlighting — keep this className on every new grid row template even if validation isn't implemented yet, since it's harmless when row_error is unset.
